description: This file defines the ResizeUrlFilter class, which implements image URL resizing and processing logic for OrchardCore media module, including handling of media commands, URL query parameters, and tokenization.

classes.name: ResizeUrlFilter
classes.description: A class implementing ILiquidFilter to process and generate resized media URLs with optional tokenization.

methods.name: ResizeUrlFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing media profile, token services, and options.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input URL and arguments to generate a resized media URL with specified parameters.

methods.name: ApplyMediaCommands
methods.description: Static helper method to apply various resize and format commands to the MediaCommands object based on input arguments.
